title: Beef Skewer Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious stir fry recipe using beef skewers and a variety of vegetables. This dish is inspired by traditional Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and carrots, and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef skewers to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until they are cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables, and stir to coat.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
